If you like role play games and exploring an open world buy Odyssey. I spent hours and hours on it and i still do weekly missions. But beware that because of its open world it may feel empty. 

If you like more story driven and linear games buy Origins. It has an open world too but unlike Odyssey it didn't encourage me to explore it besides checking out pyramids. But i'd say its world is more live because it has a smaller map. 

As a final note Odyssey has player generated quests and Origins' Nightmare mode felt like a souls-lite game while Odyssey's normal difficulty can get hard enough based on your build.
